title: Building An AI driven interactive Story/RPG
author: WhiplashNinja
selftext:
Its pretty cool, i even put my partners unfinished book as a concept in it. Im actually surprised at how well the AI is handling things.

Anyone else making AI story experiences?

comments.author: Material_Control_989
comments.body: I haven’t tried it yet, but I’m interested in doing so. How are you integrating it?

replies.author: WhiplashNinja
replies.body:
I'm running it in the perchance system for now. It's my prototype tesimg area. It has the free AI plugins so I can build my engine to drive the AI. It's all browser based at this point, but when everything lands clean and works, I'll be porting it to mobile and PC and including a low level LLM to run locally once a system requirements check has occured. If users specs don't stand up for text generation and image generation, only then will it inform users that they have to sign up and pay.

But the key is it is designed as a free feature, so instead of users getting slapped with a (give me money!) it will be "This is supposed to be free, but your device can't do it"

comments.author: LeD90imp
comments.body: Oui, c’est très cool ! J’ai, moi aussi, créé un jeu d’histoire RPG. J’aime beaucoup tout ce qu’on peut faire dès qu’on a les idées en tête.
